类 PlayerBedEnterEvent

Cancellable
public class PlayerBedEnterEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
玩家准备躺到床上时触发此事件.

原文： This event is fired when the player is almost about to enter the bed.

      @NotNull public @NotNull Event.Result useBed()
      控制对点击的床采取的操作.

      原文： This controls the action to take with the bed that was clicked on.

      In case of Event.Result.DEFAULT, the default outcome is described by enterAction().

      返回:
      对交互的床采取的操作

      原文：the action to take with the interacted bed

      • setUseBed(Result)

    • setUseBed

      public void setUseBed(@NotNull @NotNull Event.Result useBed)
      设置对交互的床采取的操作.

      原文： Sets the action to take with the interacted bed.

      Event.Result.ALLOW will result in the player sleeping, regardless of the default outcome described by enterAction().
      Event.Result.DENY will prevent the player from sleeping. This has the same effect as canceling the event via setCancelled(boolean).
      Event.Result.DEFAULT will result in the outcome described by enterAction().

      参数:
      useBed - 对交互的床采取的操作

      原文：the action to take with the interacted bed

      另请参阅:
      • useBed()

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      获取此事件的取消状态。设置为 true 以阻止玩家睡觉.

      原文： Gets the cancellation state of this event. Set to true if you want to prevent the player from sleeping.

      Canceling the event has the same effect as setting useBed() to Event.Result.DENY.

      For backwards compatibility reasons this also returns true if useBed() is Event.Result.DEFAULT and the default action is to prevent bed entering.

      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      布尔值取消状态

      原文：boolean cancellation state

    • setCancelled

      public void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      设置此事件的取消状态。取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件.

      原文： 取消这个事件. 一个被取消的事件不会在 服务器里执行，但是仍然会传递事件到其他插件.

      原文： Sets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins.

      Canceling this event will prevent use of the bed.

      指定者:
      setCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      参数:
      cancel - 如果希望取消此事件则为 true
